mainEntity.name: Can an existing garage be converted into a guest suite?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, converting an attached garage is a common way to create a guest suite without expanding your home's exterior footprint. A practical tradeoff is losing enclosed vehicle parking and storage space in exchange for livable, conditioned square footage. The conversion involves raising the floor to match the main home, insulating exterior walls, framing interior partitions for a private bathroom, and installing drywall. You must also account for climate control, either by extending the central HVAC system or adding an independent mini-split system. Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms assesses your garage slab and ceiling heights during planning.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, an attached garage can be converted into a guest suite, provided the floor is leveled, walls are insulated, and heating, cooling, and plumbing lines are properly added.
